name: Manik Khajuria
description:
I'm Manik Khajuria, a Google Summer of Code 2026 contributor with FOSSASIA and a student at NIT Jalandhar (class of 2028). Since March 2026, I've had 92 pull requests merged into Visdom, FOSSASIA's open source dashboard for machine learning experiments with over 10,000 GitHub stars.

My work covers five layers of the project: a storage abstraction layer, an experiment search layer with an injection-safe query parser, a hyper-parameter tracking dashboard, a pytest suite of nearly 1500+ tests, and the migration of Visdom's server and client to asyncio. Along the way I also shipped security fixes, new ML plots such as ROC curves and confusion matrices, and the React 19 upgrade.

Outside open source, I'm a competitive programmer with over 2,000+ DSA problems solved. I've completed two internships, and I build with Python, React and Next.js.
